create.name: Linda Star Wolf
create.bio:
Shamanic Breathwork, the ceremonial practice created by shamanic teacher Linda Star Wolf, combines cyclical breathing, chakra-attuned music, bodywork, art and group sharing. In the 1970s she started out as a therapist and counsellor, and she studied breathwork and consciousness with teachers including Ram Dass, Leonard Orr, Stanislav Grof and Jacquelyn Small. During the 1990s she trained with the Eupsychia Institute and studied the Wolf Clan teachings of Twylah Nitsch, a Seneca elder who adopted her as a spiritual granddaughter and gave her the name Star Wolf.

On Dove Mountain in North Carolina she founded the Venus Rising Association for Transformation and Venus Rising University. There, students follow a training path she calls S.H.I.P., an initiatory shamanic process, to become Shamanic Breathwork facilitators and shamanic ministers. She and her husband, Nikólaus Wolf, lead Shamanic Mystery Tours to sacred sites in Egypt, Peru, Bali and elsewhere, and host small retreats in Portugal. Thirteen books carry her name as author or co-author, including Shamanic Breathwork, Visionary Shamanism, Shamanic Mysteries of Egypt with Nicki Scully, and The Aquarian Shaman, which is also the name of the broadcast she hosts. She teaches on The Shift Network.

books.title: Shamanic Breathwork: Journeying beyond the Limits of the Self
books.author: Linda Star Wolf
books.description: Her core book on the Shamanic Breathwork process, joining breath, music, ceremony and psychospiritual tools in a journey through the chakras and the elements. It explains how the practice developed and how it is used for inner change.

books.title: The Aquarian Shaman: Walking the Spiral Path of Transformation
books.author: Linda Star Wolf
books.description: A guide to her spiral model of transformation, drawing on decades of teaching. It shares shamanic practices, rituals and ceremonies for working through cycles of change. Foreword by Lee McCormick.

books.title: Visionary Shamanism: Activating the Imaginal Cells of the Human Energy Field
books.author: Linda Star Wolf, Anne Dillon
books.description: Uses the image of the caterpillar becoming a butterfly to describe inner transformation. It offers shamanic practices and journeys for awakening vision and creativity. Foreword by Barbara Hand Clow.

books.title: Shamanic Mysteries of Egypt: Awakening the Healing Power of the Heart
books.author: Nicki Scully, Linda Star Wolf
books.description: Draws on the myths and temples of ancient Egypt, especially the gods Anubis, Isis and Osiris, to offer guided journeys and initiations. Written from the authors' years of leading groups to Egypt's sacred sites.

books.title: The Anubis Oracle: A Journey into the Shamanic Mysteries of Egypt
books.author: Nicki Scully, Linda Star Wolf
books.description: An oracle deck and guidebook based on the gods and goddesses of ancient Egypt, illustrated by Kris Waldherr. Each card is linked to a teaching or journey from the Egyptian mysteries.

books.title: Shamanic Egyptian Astrology: Your Planetary Relationship to the Gods
books.author: Linda Star Wolf, Ruby Falconer
books.description: Pairs the planets of the birth chart with Egyptian deities and offers shamanic journeys to meet each one. It is meant as a way to explore your chart through myth and ritual.

books.title: Sacred Medicine of Bee, Butterfly, Earthworm, and Spider: Shamanic Teachers of the Instar Medicine Wheel
books.author: Linda Star Wolf, Anna Cariad-Barrett
books.description: Presents four small creatures as teachers of a medicine wheel of change, each linked to a stage of growth. It includes ceremonies and practices for each direction.

books.title: The 30 Shamanic Questions for Humanity: From Ego Agenda to Soul Purpose...Remembering the Bigger Picture
books.author: Linda Star Wolf
books.description: Thirty questions for reflection, each meant to move the reader from personal concerns towards a sense of soul purpose. A short book for personal or group enquiry.

books.title: Shamanic Mysteries of Peru: The Heart Wisdom of the High Andes
books.author: Vera Lopez, Linda Star Wolf
books.description: Andean shamanic teachings and practices drawn from the sacred sites of the High Andes, written with Vera Lopez. It invites readers into the heart-centred wisdom of the Peruvian tradition.

books.title: Spirit of the Wolf: Channeling the Transformative Power of Lupine Energy
books.author: Linda Star Wolf, Casey Piscitelli
books.description: Explores the wolf as a spirit teacher and guide. It offers reflections and practices for working with wolf energy in personal transformation.

courses.title: Awaken the Shaman Within: Journey Beyond the Limits of the Self
courses.description: A five-module online course on shamanic history and practice, with videos, ceremonies, meditations, guided journeys and a Shamanic Breathwork session. It covers connecting with ancestors and power animals and ends with integration.

courses.title: Shakti Rising: Activating Your Elemental Forces Within
courses.description: A six-part online course for women that moves through water, earth, fire, air and spirit, pairing each with a goddess archetype, ritual and journaling. Includes videos and downloadable materials.

courses.title: Online Shamanic Breathwork Ceremony with Star Wolf
courses.description: A recorded ninety-minute Shamanic Breathwork ceremony guided by Star Wolf, to take at home after signing a release form.

courses.title: S.H.I.P. ~ Shamanic Healing Initiatory Process Online Program
courses.description: The first level of Venus Rising's Shamanic Breathwork training, held online over two weeks in four-hour evening sessions (UK time). It moves through six elemental initiations, each centred on a Shamanic Breathwork journey.

courses.title: Fortuna Villa Experience
courses.description: A private retreat of six to eight days for two to six guests at Star Wolf and Nikólaus Wolf's home in Lourinhã on Portugal's Silver Coast. Each programme is planned with the group and may include Shamanic Breathwork, ceremony and excursions.
courses.price: Approximately $500 USD per person, per day

courses.title: Venus Rising University degree programmes
courses.description: Bachelor's, master's and doctoral programmes in shamanic and psychospiritual studies from the university she founded, built on the S.H.I.P. training, life experience credits and a project or dissertation.
courses.price: From $6,000 USD (Master's); Bachelor's $9,000 USD; Doctorates $7,500 USD
